HELLOVOICE

Healthcare-first film studio

Campaign films, patient education, medical animation and immersive technology for AstraZeneca, Pfizer, Bayer, AbbVie and Boston Scientific.

Follow usInstagram
627+Films delivered in FY25

HelloVoice is a Riyadh film studio. Two thirds of what we make is healthcare and pharma — work that has to clear review and still be worth watching.

More about the studioMore about the studio

The studio opens

2019

HelloVoice starts in Riyadh as a small crew making corporate film for Saudi brands, with one edit suite and a habit of saying yes to difficult briefs.

Healthcare takes over

2021

The first pharmaceutical accounts arrive and change how the studio works. Scripts start being written for medical review, not just for the screen.

Arabic and English together

2022

Bilingual delivery becomes the default rather than a post-production step, which changes timing, on-screen text and how voice is directed.

Congress speed

2023

An editor starts travelling to events so recap films cut and deliver while the congress is still running.

Animation and CGI

2024

Medical and scientific animation grows into its own department, alongside anamorphic DOOH and 3D work for retail and exhibition.

627 films

2025

The busiest year on record. Fifty-plus clients across eight industries, and the studio's first mixed-reality and VR builds.

How the work gets made

Brief to delivery

Step 01

Brief

Brief

We start with what the film has to achieve, who signs it off, and what it cannot say. On healthcare work the constraints shape the idea, so we surface them before anyone writes a word.

Step 02

Script & storyboard

Script & storyboard

Scripts and boards go to medical, legal and regulatory before a camera is booked. The expensive mistake at this stage is a re-shoot; the cheap one is a re-write.

Step 03

Production

Production

Crew, cast, location and kit, in Riyadh or wherever the brief goes. Bilingual direction on the day, so the Arabic and the English are performed rather than dubbed.

Step 04

Delivery

Delivery

Grade, online, versioning and localisation. Every cut-down, aspect ratio and language sized for the platform it actually runs on.

The studio

We listen to your vision, shape it with strategy, and bring it to life through storytelling — video, visuals and experiences that move an audience and grow a brand.

50+Clients served
627+Films delivered in FY25
22Production services
8Industries covered

HelloVoice is a media production studio in Riyadh working with multinational healthcare and consumer brands across the Gulf. Most of what we make is for pharmaceutical, dermatology and medical device companies, where a film has to be accurate and approvable as well as good.

In FY26 we served 28 clients, sixteen of them new, and 46% of revenue came from services launched inside the previous twelve months — influencer and UGC campaigns, and immersive technology for exhibitions and booth activations.

That mix is deliberate. A brand that needs a congress recap on Thursday and a mixed-reality training build in the same quarter should not need two suppliers.

How we work

Three commitments

Built for review

Built for review

Scripts and storyboards structured so medical, legal and regulatory sign before anything is shot. The expensive mistake here is a re-shoot, not a re-write.

Bilingual by default

Bilingual by default

Arabic and English planned together, never translated afterwards. It changes timing, on-screen text and voice direction.

Congress speed

Congress speed

Recap films cut and delivered while the event is still running — an editor on site and approval routes agreed before anyone travels.
